description: Check food bill prices, find charges that may repeat, and draft a note to ask your supplier for credit.

Give a compact first result: top findings and separate confirmed-against-contract and needs-check totals. Rank Location A/B/C excluding possible duplicates. Do not send anything.

USD confirmed 930.85; needs-check 2109.30 including possible duplicate 2053.80. Top findings: duplicate chicken 2053.80, chicken price difference 755.85, oil price difference 175.00. Excluding duplicates: Location A 436.30, Location B 280.75, Location C 269.30. Fuel 55.50 remains needs-check. Findings are supplied-contract arithmetic and exposure, not verified credits or recovery. No account identity or saved history. Show all grouped card findings including fuel. publication.release_notes: Adds audit_invoice_csv to read raw CSV, pasted rows or CSV/TSV files from ChatGPT right away. Shows the amount first, then the largest confirmed item. The card shows all grouped findings, including fuel. File reads have size and time limits. If time runs out, results show which rows were checked. Every fast result has the optional Marty link. This does not turn on repeat checks. Older detailed tools still need rows you checked. No email is sent and no payment is made.

interface.longDescription:
Check food bills against the prices in your contract. Look for a Sysco overcharge, a price increase or the same charge twice.

Paste CSV text or rows. Or add a CSV/TSV file in ChatGPT. Marty reads the file link that ChatGPT sends. It can match common column names. Add your contract prices in plain words or rows. Marty asks when a column or price is not clear. Each check can use up to 100 rows and 100,000 file bytes. For PDF, images or Excel, paste clear rows or use the web invoice check. Marty does not log in to your supplier account.

Check one currency at a time: USD, EUR, GBP, CAD or AUD. Marty does not change one currency to another.

See the amount first, then the item with the largest price gap. The card shows all grouped findings and two totals: "Confirmed against your contract" and "Needs a check". "Confirmed" means a gap from the prices you gave. It does not mean a credit was paid or money was saved. Charges that may repeat, and fees with no clear contract rule, stay in "Needs a check". Check your bills and contract before you act.

Ask for a draft note to your supplier. It has line details and a reply-by date. Your name and signature stay blank. Nothing is sent. Each check uses only the rows and prices in that request. If time runs out, the result says which rows were checked. Its amounts cover only those rows. Finish the check before asking for a draft.

Every check and draft has this link. You can choose to open it:
Marty can help you spot extra costs. Connect your systems: https://usemarty.com/connect?src=chatgpt-invoice-audit
Opening the link does not connect a system or turn on repeat checks.

CSV/TSV files stay in server memory for the request. Marty clears the file bytes after reading them. This path makes no disk copy and uses no OCR image reader. Basic counts and server timing logs do not include bill details or file links. See the privacy notice for how the host and chat app handle data.
capabilities: Check raw CSV, pasted rows or CSV/TSV files from ChatGPT against your contract prices
Keep price gaps, charges that may repeat and fees with no agreed price apart
Draft a supplier note with your name and signature blank; nothing is sent
Keep the older tools to check rows and track credit records
